scripts.dev: start "Backend" cmd /k "cd backend && .venv\Scripts\uvicorn.exe app:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000" && start "Frontend" cmd /k "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.install:backend: cd backend && python -m venv .venv && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.setup: npm run install:frontend && npm run install:backend
